changes: Extract SSD1306Core and VirtualBMP280; remove unrelated device and UI code.
Replace OLED DOM rendering with serializable 1024-byte visible framebuffer snapshot.
Use MicroExplore bus adapter for addressing, electrical checks and transaction boundaries.
Extract ATmega2560 port, timer, ADC and UART0 register configuration into mega_config.ts; adapt to avr8js 0.21.1 with extended SRAM allocation.
limitations: BMP280 register-level model; conversion latency, filter and oversampling noise are not modeled.
SSD1306 128x64 basic addressing/display controls; scrolling and analog brightness are not fidelity-certified.
Mega integration does not expose SPI or UART1/2/3; extra R3 duplicate I2C header contacts are omitted from artwork.
